title: Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models into Efficient Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2610.01435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance through in-context learning, yet repeatedly conditioning on labeled data makes inference expensive. Knowledge distillation can reduce this cost by transferring their predictive ability to lightweight, dataset-specific students. However, the dependence of TFM predictions on both a labeled context and a query introduces two design questions: how to construct teacher supervision and whether expanding query coverage improves distillation. We examine these questions across two TFMs and both neural and tree-based students, and derive an effective distillation recipe. The recipe uses the full labeled training set as teacher context and trains students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries. translated_title: 将表格基础模型蒸馏为高效预测器
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习实现了强大的预测性能，但反复以标注数据为条件进行推理使得推理成本高昂。知识蒸馏可以通过将这些模型的预测能力迁移到轻量级的、针对特定数据集的学生模型中来降低这一成本。然而，表格基础模型的预测同时依赖于标注上下文和查询，这引出了两个设计问题：如何构建教师监督，以及扩大查询覆盖范围是否能改善蒸馏效果。我们在两个表格基础模型上，并同时针对神经网络和树模型两类学生模型考察了这些问题，并推导出一种有效的蒸馏配方。该配方使用完整的标注训练集作为教师上下文，并仅基于教师对观测查询和合成查询的预测来训练学生模型。在 TabArena 上，所得到的学生模型比经过监督训练、调优并集成后的对应模型高出 57-98 Elo 分。将该方法原封不动地应用于 TALENT 基准，结果同样
tldr: 本文提出一种有效的表格基础模型蒸馏配方——以完整标注训练集作为教师上下文，仅用教师对观测和合成查询的预测训练轻量级学生模型，使其在 TabArena 上比经调优和集成的监督学习基线高出 57-98 Elo 分。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an effective distillation recipe for tabular foundation models—using the full labeled training set as teacher context and training lightweight students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries—yielding 57-98 Elo point gains over tuned supervised baselines on TabArena.
